messages:
emi: quick heads-up, orion-lite q4_0 -> fp16 comparison on zh-Hans->en devset shows BLEU -2.7. pattern: decimal points in percentages/prices sometimes become fullwidth dot (U+FF0E) or a thin no-break space (U+2009) gets inserted between integer and fraction. breaks a lot of numeric parsers.
raj: can you paste a tiny repro + token traces? sounds like detok normalization or a byte-mapping issue in the q4 detok path.
emi: minimal repro below

```
input: 2025 年 增长 3.5% 。
baseline (fp16): Growth in 2025 was 3.5%.
orion-q4: Growth in 2025 was 3\u20095\uff05.
```

emi: sometimes it renders as 3\uff0e5% instead (fullwidth dot inserted). both variants break our numeric regex /\d+\.\d+%/ used by analytics ingestion.
ci-bot: eval job #33445 finished: BLEU delta -2.7 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/orion-q4/33445
raj: token traces?
emi: baseline.tokens: ["2025"," ","\u5e74"," ","\u589e\u957f"," ","3",".5","%","."]
orion-q4.tokens: ["2025"," ","\u5e74"," ","\u589e\u957f"," ","3\u2009","5","\uff05","."]

raj: interesting  the decimal dot got split into two characters in the detok output (thin space + digit) or remapped to a fullwidth dot. Could be a remap table entry for '.' that after quant packing becomes a different codepoint for some indices, or a buffer write that inserts a U+2009 as a separator for locale-aware grouping but got applied in the wrong context.
infra-sam: any immediate customer impact?
ops-yan: a couple of downstream analytic jobs in canary failed to match percentages and dropped records; rolling affected route to fp16 now.
ops-yan: routing change: zh->en canary -> fp16 (applied).
emi: repro script: /tmp/orion-decimal-quirk.sh; export commit: c9d7ef4; quant flags: --mode q4_0 --detok-mode unicode-smart.
raj: short term mitigation: add a post-detok sanitizer in the serving shim that 1) collapses any of [U+2009, U+00A0, U+202F] between digits to nothing or ASCII '.' depending on context, 2) re-map U+FF0E to '.' when between digits. cheap and reversible. I'll draft a tiny PR.
emi: please also add failing examples to tests/locale/zh_decimal_sanity.json so CI catches regressions.
ci-bot: creating bisect job: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-33446 (est ~90m)
raj: long-term: export-suite should dump detok remap bytes for FP16 vs quant exports and assert diffs are empty. and ensure remap buffers are explicitly zero-initialized before packing. this would have caught missing init or packing endianness differences.
ops-yan: filed ticket RD-8533 "Quantized detok introduces U+FF0E/U+2009 in numeric decimal contexts for CJK -> en outputs" and tagged eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra. https://tickets.internal/RD-8533
infra-sam: will also add a temporary warning metric for parsed-numeric-failures so we spot regressions quickly.
emi: thanks — sanitizer + routing fallback should stop customer errors while bisect runs. pinging when bisect narrows commit range. :thumbsup:
